b2-szecesszio-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The New Capital
b2-szecesszio-01.scenario: On the Andrássy út, a visitor asks you when Budapest was formed and what the Board of Public Works did.
b2-szecesszio-01.prompt: Tell him when the three towns united and what the avenue connects.
cues: Say which towns united and when
b2-szecesszio-01.target: 1873-ban Buda, Pest és Óbuda egyesülésével megszületett Budapest. A belvárost a Városligettel összekötő Andrássy út európai léptékű sugárút lett.
b2-szecesszio-01.english: In 1873 Budapest was born through the unification of Buda, Pest and Óbuda. Andrássy Avenue, connecting the downtown with the City Park, became a boulevard on a European scale.
b2-szecesszio-01.canDo: I can explain the 1873 unification of Buda, Pest, and Óbuda and the work of the Board of Public Works.

b2-szecesszio-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Postal Savings Bank
b2-szecesszio-02.scenario: In the Hold utca, a guide asks you who designed the Postal Savings Bank and which museum is another of his buildings.
b2-szecesszio-02.prompt: Tell him who designed the bank and when the Museum of Applied Arts was inaugurated.
cues: Say who designed the Postal Savings Bank
Say when the Museum of Applied Arts was inaugurated
b2-szecesszio-02.target: A Lechner Ödön által tervezett Postatakarékpénztár a Hold utcában áll. Az 1896-ban felavatott Iparművészeti Múzeum merészen szakított a historizmussal.
b2-szecesszio-02.english: The Postal Savings Bank designed by Ödön Lechner stands on Hold Street. The Museum of Applied Arts, inaugurated in 1896, boldly broke with historicism.
b2-szecesszio-02.canDo: I can explain Ödön Lechner's architectural philosophy and his major Budapest masterpieces.

b2-szecesszio-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Zsolnay Roof Tiles
b2-szecesszio-03.scenario: In front of a Secession roof, a visitor asks you why the tiles still shine and where they came from.
b2-szecesszio-03.prompt: Tell her what the tiles are made of and where the material was developed.
cues: Say where the pyrogranite was developed
Say what the tiles are coated with
b2-szecesszio-03.target: A Zsolnay-gyárban kifejlesztett pirogránit teljesen fagyállónak bizonyult. A színes mázzal bevont tetőcserepek új színt vittek a budapesti látképbe.
b2-szecesszio-03.english: The pyrogranite developed in the Zsolnay factory proved completely frost-resistant. The roof tiles coated with colorful glaze brought new colour to the Budapest skyline.
b2-szecesszio-03.canDo: I can explain the technological innovation of Vilmos Zsolnay's pyrogranite and eosin glazes in Pécs.

b2-szecesszio-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Life in a Bérház
b2-szecesszio-04.scenario: In a courtyard of the Nagykörút, a neighbour asks you how a tenement house was arranged.
b2-szecesszio-04.prompt: Tell him who lived on the street side and what ran along the courtyard.
cues: Say what the apartments facing the street had
Say what lined the courtyard galleries
b2-szecesszio-04.target: Az utcára néző lakásokban tágas szalonok voltak, a belső udvarra nyíló függőfolyosók mentén viszont kisebb lakások sorakoztak.
b2-szecesszio-04.english: In the apartments facing the street there were spacious salons, whereas along the galleries opening onto the inner courtyard smaller flats were lined up.
b2-szecesszio-04.canDo: I can explain the social geography of a Budapest bérház (courtyard tenement) from street-front apartments to inner galleries.

b2-szecesszio-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Reading the Facades
b2-szecesszio-05.scenario: On the Szervita tér, a student asks you what is special about the Rózsavölgyi House and how old facades are treated today.
b2-szecesszio-05.prompt: Tell her when the Rózsavölgyi House was built and what should be preserved.
cues: Say when and where it was built
b2-szecesszio-05.target: A Szervita téren 1912-ben felépült Rózsavölgyi-ház a modern építészet előfutára volt. A megőrzendő műemléki értékeket gondosan restaurálják.
b2-szecesszio-05.english: The Rózsavölgyi House built in 1912 on Szervita Square was a forerunner of modern architecture. The heritage values to be preserved are carefully restored.
b2-szecesszio-05.canDo: I can trace how Hungarian Secession moved from floral decoration to Béla Lajta's geometric forms, and how its facades are looked after today.

b2-szecesszio-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: A Walk through Secession Budapest
b2-szecesszio-consolidation.scenario: On a walk along the Andrássy út, a visitor asks you to sum up what you have learnt about Lechner and Zsolnay.
b2-szecesszio-consolidation.prompt: Tell him who designed the Postal Savings Bank and what the tiles of Zsolnay are like.
cues: Say who designed the Postal Savings Bank
Say what the roof tiles are coated with
b2-szecesszio-consolidation.target: A Lechner Ödön által tervezett Postatakarékpénztár a Hold utcában áll. A színes mázzal bevont tetőcserepek a pécsi Zsolnay-gyárban készültek.
b2-szecesszio-consolidation.english: The Postal Savings Bank designed by Ödön Lechner stands on Hold Street. The roof tiles coated with colorful glaze were made in the Zsolnay factory in Pécs.
b2-szecesszio-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about Budapest's unification, Ödön Lechner's Secession buildings and Zsolnay ceramics.
